failure_summary: Gate 2 (output range) failed. The iterative_belief_refiner creates an unbounded positive feedback loop: h_full += ReLU(W_fb * scores) only adds non-negative values, and recomputing correlations on the enlarged h_full produces larger scores each iteration. Despite this, the architecture converges perfectly on toy problems (Gate 3), suggesting the relative ordering of scores carries correct information even at high magnitude. A fix would be to normalize scores by sqrt(224) or apply LayerNorm before correlation, but as specified the outputs exceed the [-100, 100] bound.
